title: Temporal gains in academic-risk prediction depend on outcome definitions and evaluation conditions: reproduction code and evidence

creators.name: Miao, Shaowei
creators.affiliation: Zhongyuan University of Science and Technology; INTI International University

description: Reproduction source and frozen evidence for the academic-risk prediction study. Includes historical E1–E14 verification and selected replays, plus reviewer-revision complete-risk-set temporal controls, same-family representation comparisons, nested development stability, probability-calibration diagnostics and screening coverage. Provides raw-OULAD reconstruction of the new controls, selected LOMO LR replay, and archived-input calibration diagnostics. Authors code is MIT; derived data retain the original datasets CC BY 4.0 attribution. Raw logs, manuscript documents and reviewer reports are omitted. The later analyses reuse previously inspected data and are exploratory; calendar proxies do not establish real-time label availability. See README for executable scope, exclusions and commands.
